title: Balochistan Maintenance of Public Order Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Maintenance of Public Order Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE IX OF 2002
BALOCHISTAN
MAINTENANCE OF PUBLIC ORDER (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE IX OF 2002
An Ordinance further to amend the Balochistan Maintenance of Public Order,
Ordinance, 1960
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 25th April, 2002]
No. Legis. 2-42/Law/79-IV,
dated 25-4-2002.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 13th April, 2002, is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Balochistan Maintenance
of Public Order (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Maintenance of Public Order Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Amendment of section 3 of Ordinance, XXXI of 1960

ORDINANCE IX OF 2002
BALOCHISTAN
MAINTENANCE OF PUBLIC ORDER (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE IX OF 2002
An Ordinance further to amend the Balochistan Maintenance of Public Order,
Ordinance, 1960
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 25th April, 2002]
No. Legis. 2-42/Law/79-IV,
dated 25-4-2002.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 13th April, 2002, is hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 3 of
Ordinance, XXXI of 1960.--In the Balochistan Maintenance of Public Order
Ordinance, 1960, hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance in section 3,--
(a) in subsection (2) for the
words "Zila Nazim" the words "District Administrative Officer in
'B' Area and District Police Officer in 'A' Area" shall be substituted;
(b) in subsection (8) for the
words "Zila Nazim" appearing twice the words "District
Administrative Officer in 'B' Area and, District Police Officer in 'A'
Area" shall be substituted;
(c) in subsection (10) for the
words "Zila Nazim" the words "District Administrative Officer in
'B' Area and District Police Officer in '.A' Area" shall be substituted.

5. Amendment of section 26 of
Ordinance, XXXI of 1960.----In the said Ordinance, for section 26, the
following shall be substituted:--
"26. Delegation of power.--Government
may, by order in writing direct that the power under subsection (1) of section
3, shall subject to such restrictions as may be specified, be exercisable by
